g.text: Draft — spends money, writes nothing real
"plan next week" / a chat turn that plans
real ids, sane times, inside the week
Two stores, one path: a week drafted from the
week tab and one drafted mid-chat land in the
same row and are booked by the same accept.
The chat turn records only which Monday.
DayLogService differs in one way: its draft is a set
of CHANGES. Null means "leave what is there", and the
merge happens at read time against the day as it
stands now — so the card shows what saving will write.
